title: How the Neovim Lua plugin builds and renders the tree

node-1.label: :FlowTraceOpen command calls flowtrace.open
node-1.summary: The plugin file registers the :FlowTraceOpen user command and forwards its argument to require('flowtrace').open(opts.args).

node-2.label: M.open starts the viewer state
node-2.summary: The public open function stores the artifact path, loads JSON into state.flow, creates the window, installs keymaps, then redraws.

node-3.label: parser.load decodes the .flow.json artifact
node-3.summary: The parser reads the artifact, decodes JSON with vim.json.decode, and checks that root and nodes exist.

node-4.label: window.open_buffer creates the side tree buffer
node-4.summary: The window module opens a left-side vertical split, marks it nofile, sets filetype=flowtrace, turns on wrapping for this pane only, enables cursorline, and hides line numbers.

node-5.label: redraw asks tree.render for display lines and node index
node-5.summary: redraw receives readable lines plus highlight spans and an index mapping visible buffer rows back to flow node ids, then writes the buffer and applies extmark colors.

node-6.label: tree.render seeds header and traverses from flow.root
node-6.summary: tree.render creates the title/help lines and calls add_node on the root id with the current expanded/collapsed state.

node-7.label: add_node recursively flattens children and branches
node-7.summary: add_node formats readable label, metadata, file, and summary rows, records all rows in the index, adds highlight spans, respects expansion state, prevents cycles with seen, then walks children and branch targets.
node-7.anchor: local function add_node(lines, index, highlights, flow, expanded, id, depth, branch_label, seen)

node-8.label: setup_keys wires tree rows to actions
node-8.summary: Keymaps use the row-to-node index. <CR> jumps, p previews, ? shows details, o toggles expanded state and redraws, r reloads, q closes.

branches.label: press o to expand/collapse and rerender

node-9.label: o toggles state.expanded and calls redraw
node-9.summary: The toggle handler finds the current row's node id, flips its expansion boolean, and rebuilds the buffer contents.
node-9.anchor: state.expanded[item.id] = state.expanded[item.id] == false and true or false; redraw()

node-10.label: actions.jump opens the node file and positions the cursor
node-10.summary: The jump action looks up the current row in state.index, switches to the source/code window on the right, edits node.file there, and sets the cursor while leaving the tree open on the left.
